Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Technology is advancing with a startling pace, and some people have trouble keeping up with the most modern aspects. A recent interview with a middle-aged guy and a high schooler aimed to get at just this issue. Only one of the two had difficulties, though. The middle-aged guy found that they actually enjoyed adapting to the newest high-tech toy, and it was only the high schooler who found the whole processing too exhausting, and kind of gave up completely already. Who is up to date with modern times?
A. The middle-aged guy
B. Can't answer
C. The high schooler
